columns.name: externalField
columns.description: External system field identifier, such as HL7 segment path, FHIR element path, REST JSON path, or file column name.

columns.name: standardResource
columns.description: One API-01 standard context resource: Patient, Encounter, Condition, Observation, Medication, Procedure, DiagnosticReport, Document, NursingAssessment, CarePlan, FollowUp, or Claim.

columns.name: standardPath
columns.description: MedKernel canonical path inside the target standard resource.

columns.name: required
columns.description: Whether missing value blocks ingestion for the current event type.

columns.name: terminologyStrategy
columns.description: NONE, EXACT_CODE, TERM_01_MAPPING, or MANUAL_REVIEW. Clinical codes must not be silently guessed.

columns.name: sourceEvidence
columns.description: Whether the original source field and raw value must be retained in audit evidence.

mappingRule.rawPayloadRetention: Store only governed audit evidence; do not persist secrets or excessive patient payload in connector config.
